title: NSW contract for sale and disclosure documents
description: What a NSW seller usually gathers so the contract for sale, with its prescribed documents, is ready before the property is advertised. Summarised from NSW Fair Trading, the Conveyancing (Sale of Land) Regulation 2022 and Service NSW; your conveyancer or solicitor confirms what applies to your sale.

sources.title: Sales contracts – requirements for property agents
Apply online for a planning certificate

items.title: Engage a solicitor or licensed conveyancer to prepare the NSW contract for sale of land
Have the contract ready before any advertising, signboard or open home
items.detail: In NSW a home can't be offered for sale until the contract has been prepared. Your agent keeps a copy for buyers to inspect.

items.title: Get the property certificate (title search) and the registered plan
Order the section 10.7 planning certificate from council
items.detail: Apply through the NSW Planning Portal if your council accepts online applications.

items.title: Collect documents for any easements, covenants or restrictions on use
Check the contract includes the smoke alarm and loose-fill asbestos warnings
Search the loose-fill asbestos insulation register for your address
Write down any material facts and give them to your agent
items.detail: For example flooding or bushfire in the last 5 years, significant health or safety risks, a murder or manslaughter in the last 5 years, drug manufacture in the last 2 years, or cladding or building rectification orders.

items.title: For a strata lot, get the strata plan, by-laws and property certificate for the common property
If there is a pool, attach a certificate of compliance, an occupation certificate with registration, or a certificate of non-compliance
items.detail: Not needed for lots in strata or community schemes of more than two lots.

items.title: Test the smoke alarms on every level and replace any over 10 years old
If tenanted, give the tenant 14 days' written notice before the first inspection
Ask your conveyancer whether a land tax clearance certificate is needed
Agree with your conveyancer how the cooling-off period will be handled
items.detail: Private sales usually have 5 business days; auctions have none.
